items.title: Lesson Podcast
items.description: Audio guide to perceptual set — how culture, motivation, emotion and expectation shape what we perceive.

items.title: All in the Mind — BBC Radio 4
items.description: Radio 4 series featuring research on how emotional state and cultural background alter perception — directly relevant to perceptual set.

items.title: AQA GCSE Psychology — Factors Affecting Perception: Motivation (Gilchrist & Nesberg)
items.description: Dedicated video on Gilchrist and Nesberg's food-deprivation study showing how motivation alters what we perceive.

items.title: Perceptual Set
items.description: Explains how expectations and context create a perceptual set that biases our interpretation of ambiguous stimuli.

items.title: Perceiving is Believing: Crash Course Psychology #7
items.description: Explores how top-down processing, context and prior experience influence perception — covering the key factors tested on the GCSE spec.

items.title: Inception
items.description: Blockbuster exploring how expectation and mental state shape the perceived world — a vivid cinematic illustration of top-down perceptual factors.

items.title: Simply Psychology — Visual Perception Theory
items.description: Includes discussion of how culture, emotion and motivation create perceptual sets — the theoretical background for this lesson.

items.title: AQA GCSE Psychology 8182 — Specification
items.description: Lists the specific factors affecting perception (culture, motivation, emotion, expectation) that are assessed at GCSE.
